claims.quote: Rasbora dorsinotata is a small rasbora from the Mekong and upper Chao Phraya river basins in northern Thailand and northern Laos.
Rasbora dorsinotata is a small rasbora from the Mekong and upper Chao Phraya river basins in northern Thailand and northern Laos.

Type locality is 'Mae Nam Huey Bon, kilometer 45 on road from Amphoe ThaWang Pha to Amphoe Chiang Kham, Chiang Rai Province, Thailand', and this species appears restricted to the Mekong and upper Chao Phraya river basins in northern Thailand and northern Laos.
